column2: Hehe, you saw me.
Th-This...
This is a sweet I made, but...
It's chocolate!
If you don't mind... won't you eat it!?
Huff... huff... But please...
Don't go off alone in secret to get $$薬$$...
Promise you won't do it again!?
...*sniff*... Idiot, idiot. You're an idiot...!
If you hadn't come back, I kept wondering what I'd do...
I was seriously worried, you know...
Huff... huff...
M-My stomach... It sort of... h-hurts...
Huff... huff...
S-Somehow, I feel sick!
When you say spring, you think stream fishing! Yamame trout, rainbow trout, amago trout, char!
They're all delicious grilled with salt~!!
In spring, wasabi flowers bloom along beautiful streams!!
Freshly grated wasabi over new buckwheat noodles... that would be irresistible!
All right! Summer's finally here!!
Summer is the season for ayu fishing! After you catch one, butterfly it right there, dry it on the rocks in the sun, and...
brush it with dengaku miso and grill it!
Doesn't that sound delicious!?
When you say summer, it's eel!
Grilled eel with wasabi makes a great tea-over-rice dish too!
Now it's time for the big fight that comes once a year!!
In autumn, salmon return from the sea to the rivers!
Catch a whole lot while you can and salt them, and you'll never run short of side dishes!
The lower reaches of the river that runs nearby connect straight to the sea, so sometimes you can catch ocean fish!!
If we're lucky this season, we might catch some returning bonito!!
Have you ever eaten the liver of a filefish?
Sprinkle it with salt and steam it lightly, then strain it and mix it with soy sauce!
Dip thin-sliced filefish sashimi, topped with scallions and spicy grated daikon, into it...
It's suuuuper delicious!!
Take a freshly caught octopus, slice it thin, grill it over charcoal, squeeze lime over it, and eat it with salt!
Don't you think that's a joy only anglers get to have!?
When I get skunked stream fishing, I make rice porridge from horsetail shoots and flowering fern growing around the fields!
And that makes me feel like spring has come!!
When I went to the field today, the eggplants were loaded with fruit, so...
if you pick some for me, I'll treat you to my special grilled eggplant~!
By now, the peanuts in the field must be starting to bear fruit!
Most people dry them before eating them, but they're delicious boiled in saltwater, too!
It's nearly the season when red leeks are delicious! Sitting around a hot pot with you...
Doesn't that feel like domestic happiness~!?
What's wrong? Could it be...
Are you feeling sick?!
Keep at your $$リハビリ$$ today, too!
Come on, get some rest! I don't think you should push yourself any further today!
A-Are you all right?
Don't push yourself, okay!?
If you get sick, that won't do anyone any good...
Please...
Just don't overdo it, okay!?
Good work today~! I heated up the bath~!
Hehe, your back...
Want me to wash it for you!?
You did your best all day again~!
I can't let you outdo me!
